pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I FEARED NOTHING. I HAD NOTHING TO LOSE. YET I HAD MY FIGHTING SPIRIT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE SPIRIT TO CHALLENGE THE YOSHI-OKA AND A QUICK TEMPER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT TOUGHENED ME UP, SHARPENED ME UP.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU WERE ABLE TO STEP INTO THAT PART OF MY LIFE NICELY, DENSHI-CHIRO.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: I LAY RESTLESS FOR 3 DAYS AND 3 NIGHTS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT’S BEEN A YEAR SINCE THEN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU’RE HALF A STEP FURTHER AWAY NOW... COMPARED TO BACK THEN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SHALL WE CALL OFF THIS DUEL?
